items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know, we got to see him when Professor Renette and I went out to California.

ctx.x: Yeah, well the piano players that I actually know, they were older than me, but the answer ones that I know who played back in Storyville during those times was Fred Washington, which was a great piano player.
You know, we got to see him when Professor Renette and I went out to California. Yeah. And he's paralyzed now too. Oh yeah? Yeah, his wife has to dress him.
